steps.action: Log in with the user that has no View Worklist permission.
steps.result: The user is logged in and sees only the pages the role allows.

steps.action: Open the copied Worklist page address in the browser.
steps.result: The Shutdown Event List page is shown and the Worklist table is not shown (existing behaviour: a path the user cannot use redirects to the Shutdown Event List without an error page).

steps.action: Look at the page.
steps.result: No Remark values appear anywhere on the page.

steps.action: Open the Planning tab of the Shutdown Event.
steps.result: The Plan Cards are shown.

steps.action: Click the Worklist row of a Plan Card.
steps.result: The Worklist page opens (in a new tab, as Plan Card rows do today) with the header `Worklist: [Plan Name]` and the work table.

steps.action: Click the filter icon on the `Remark` column header.
steps.result: A filter panel opens under the header.

steps.action: Look at the panel.
steps.result: The panel shows a search box, a `Select All` checkbox and a list of checkboxes with Remark values.

steps.action: Look for a condition dropdown.
steps.result: No dropdown with `Contains`, `Blank` or `Not blank` is shown.

steps.action: Look for a free text input used as the filter value.
steps.result: The only text input is the search box of the checkbox list.

steps.action: Click the filter icon on the `Job Owner` column header.
steps.result: The Remark panel closes and a checkbox list opens with a search box and `Select All`; no condition dropdown is shown.

steps.action: Compare the Job Owner panel with the Remark panel seen in step 4.
steps.result: Both panels have a search box, a `Select All` checkbox and a scrollable list of checkboxes.

steps.action: Click the filter icon on the `Remark` column header.
steps.result: The Remark list opens.

steps.action: Count the options named `Note 1`.
steps.result: Exactly one option `Note 1` is shown, even though two works use it.

steps.action: Tick only `Note 1`.
steps.result: The table shows exactly the two works W05 and W20.

steps.action: Untick `Note 1`.
steps.result: All works are shown again.

steps.action: Look for the options that read `Test` or `test`.
steps.result: Four separate options are listed: `Test`, `test`, one with one space before `Test` and one with one space after `Test`.

steps.action: Tick only the option `test`.
steps.result: The table shows only W02.

steps.action: Untick `test` and tick only the option with one space before `Test`.
steps.result: The table shows only W03.

steps.action: Untick it and tick only the option with one space after `Test`.
steps.result: The table shows only W04.

steps.action: Untick it and tick only `Test`.
steps.result: The table shows only W01.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens.

steps.action: Look at the row directly under `Select All`.
steps.result: The first option is `-`.

steps.action: Look at the option after `-`.
steps.result: The next option is a normal value (not `-`).

steps.action: Search the whole list for a second `-` option.
steps.result: Only one option reads `-`.

steps.action: Scroll to the end of the list.
steps.result: No `-` option is found in the middle or at the end; `-` is not part of the A to Z block (`#Urgent`, `(Hold)` and digits exist).

steps.action: Scroll back to the top of the list.
steps.result: The first option under `Select All` is `-` again.

steps.action: Read the positions of `Note 1`, `Note 2` and `Note 10`.
steps.result: The order is `Note 1`, `Note 2`, `Note 10`; `Note 10` is not before `Note 2`.

steps.action: Read all options after `-` in order.
steps.result: The options appear in four groups in this order: values that start with a symbol or space (one space before Test, ` - `, `- `, `- a`, `--`, `(Hold)`, `#Urgent`), then the value that starts with a digit (`100% ok "x" & y`), then English-letter values, then Thai (`ซ่อมด่วน`).

steps.action: Look at the English-letter group.
steps.result: The order is `Check valve 🔧`, `Long remark ...` (the 200-character one), `Note 1`, `Note 2`, `Note 10`, `test`, `Test`, `Test ` (one space after Test), `Valve A, B`; `test` is before `Test` (lowercase first).

steps.action: Look at the position of `ซ่อมด่วน`.
steps.result: It is listed last, after `Valve A, B`.

steps.action: Look at the options that start with a symbol or a space.
steps.result: They come before `100% ok "x" & y` and before all letters, in the order localeCompare('en', { numeric: true }) gives (values starting with a space or `-` before values starting with `(` or `#`); none is listed before `-`.

steps.action: Find the option that starts with `Long remark `.
steps.result: The option text ends with an ellipsis (…) and stays on one line inside the panel width.

steps.action: Move the mouse over this option.
steps.result: A hover text shows the full 200-character Remark.

steps.action: Move the mouse away.
steps.result: The hover text disappears.

steps.action: Look at the option `Note 1`.
steps.result: The full text `Note 1` is shown with no ellipsis.

steps.action: Move the mouse over the option `Note 1`.
steps.result: No tooltip appears for this short option.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens with one `-` option.

steps.action: Tick only `-`.
steps.result: The table shows exactly W11, W12 and W13.

steps.action: Look at the `Job Description` and `Remark` cells of the three rows.
steps.result: The Job Descriptions are `W11`, `W12`, `W13`; the Remark cells are empty, empty-looking (three spaces) and `-`.

steps.action: On the Work Registration form `Create Work` > `Manual Create`, keep `Remark` empty with the required fields filled.
steps.result: The `Save` button is enabled.

steps.action: Click `Save`.
steps.result: The work is saved and appears in the worklist.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick only `-`.
steps.result: The table shows W11, W12, W13 and the new work; still one `-` option.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: The filter is cleared and all works are shown.

steps.action: Open worklist A (normal Remarks plus only one work with an empty Remark) and open the `Remark` filter.
steps.result: A single `-` option is shown first.

steps.action: Tick `-`.
steps.result: Only the work with the empty Remark is shown.

steps.action: Open worklist B (normal Remarks plus only one work with a spaces-only Remark), open the `Remark` filter and tick `-`.
steps.result: A single `-` option is first and only the spaces-only work is shown.

steps.action: Open worklist C (normal Remarks plus only one work with the Remark `-`), open the `Remark` filter and tick `-`.
steps.result: A single `-` option is first and only the work with `-` is shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens.

steps.action: Look for the options `--`, `- a`, `- ` and ` - `.
steps.result: All four are listed as separate options after `-`, none merged into `-`, none trimmed; `- ` and ` - ` are two different options.

steps.action: Tick only `-`.
steps.result: The table does not show W14, W15, W21 or W22.

steps.action: Untick `-` and tick only `--`.
steps.result: The table shows only W14.

steps.action: Untick `--` and tick only `- `.
steps.result: The table shows only W21.

steps.action: Untick `- ` and tick only ` - `.
steps.result: The table shows only W22.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The first option under `Select All` is `-`; `Note 1` and `Note 2` are listed.

steps.action: Open the menu `⋮` of W11 and click `Edit Work Details`.
steps.result: The page `Edit Work Details` opens.

steps.action: Type `Filled now` in `Remark` and click `Save`.
steps.result: The work is saved without an error message.

steps.action: Open the Worklist page again from the Plan Card and open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list contains `Filled now`, `Note 1` and `Note 2`.

steps.action: Look under `Select All` and search the list for `-`.
steps.result: The first option is `Filled now`; no option reads `-` because no work has a Blank Remark.

steps.action: Open `Edit Work Details` of W05, change `Remark` to `Changed note` and click `Save`.
steps.result: The work is saved.

steps.action: Return to the Worklist table and open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: `Changed note` is listed; `Note 1` is no longer listed.

steps.action: Tick `Changed note`.
steps.result: Only W05 is shown.

steps.action: Untick it, open `Edit Work Details` of W06, change `Remark` to `note 1` (different case from another option) and click `Save`.
steps.result: The work is saved.

steps.action: Return to the Worklist table and open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: `Changed note`, `Filled now` and `note 1` are listed, and `Note 2` is no longer listed.

steps.action: Tick `note 1`.
steps.result: Only W06 is shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens and shows only the first part of the options.

steps.action: Scroll down inside the filter list.
steps.result: The list moves inside the panel; the page behind does not scroll.

steps.action: Scroll to the end.
steps.result: `Remark 060` is shown last and can be ticked.

steps.action: Close the filter without ticking an option.
steps.result: The filter closes and the table is unchanged.

steps.action: Look at the `Remark` cell of W17 in the table.
steps.result: The text is cut with an ellipsis (…).

steps.action: Move the mouse over the cell.
steps.result: A hover text shows the full 200-character Remark.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and close it without ticking.
steps.result: The cell of W17 still shows the ellipsis, nothing changed.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick `Note 2`.
steps.result: The option is ticked.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: Only W06 is shown and `Total Results` equals 1.

steps.action: Untick `Note 2`.
steps.result: All works are shown again.

steps.action: Tick `Note 1` and `Note 10`.
steps.result: Both options are ticked.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: Only W05 and W07 are shown.

steps.action: Also tick `-`.
steps.result: The table shows W05, W07, W11, W12 and W13.

steps.action: Untick `Note 1`.
steps.result: `Note 10` and `-` stay ticked; the table shows W07, W11, W12 and W13.

steps.action: Untick `Note 10`.
steps.result: Only `-` stays ticked; the table shows exactly W11, W12 and W13 (W14 `--` is not shown) and `Total Results` shows 3, equal to the number of rows.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Job Description` column and tick `Select All`.
steps.result: Every option is ticked.

steps.action: Untick `Select All` in the `Job Description` filter.
steps.result: Every option is unticked; the number of rows shown by the table is written down as the Job Description reference.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick `Select All`.
steps.result: Every option is ticked and the table shows all works.

steps.action: Untick `Note 1`.
steps.result: The table shows all works except W05; `Select All` shows the same partly ticked state as the `Job Description` filter does in the same situation.

steps.action: Untick `Select All`.
steps.result: Every option is unticked.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: The table shows the same number of rows as the Job Description reference from step 11.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Tick one option in the `Job Description` filter and untick it again.
steps.result: No option is ticked and the number of rows shown is written down as the single-untick reference.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick only `Note 1`.
steps.result: Only W05 is shown.

steps.action: Untick `Note 1`.
steps.result: No option is ticked.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: The table shows the same number of rows as the single-untick reference from step 18.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and type `note` in the search box.
steps.result: The list shows only `Note 1`, `Note 2` and `Note 10`, the same way the `Job Description` filter lists options such as `W01` when `w0` is typed in lowercase.

steps.action: Type `NOTE 1` instead.
steps.result: The list shows `Note 1` and `Note 10`; letter case is ignored exactly as in the `Job Description` filter with `W0`.

steps.action: Clear the search box.
steps.result: The full list is shown again.

steps.action: Type `Note` in the search box.
steps.result: Three options are listed.

steps.action: Tick `Select All`.
steps.result: The three Note options are ticked.

steps.action: Clear the search box.
steps.result: The other options are not ticked.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: Only W05, W06 and W07 are shown.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and note the number of rows in the table.
steps.result: The row count is written down.

steps.action: Type `zzzz` in the search box.
steps.result: No value option is listed under `Select All` and no `-` option is listed.

steps.action: Tick `Select All`.
steps.result: No row is added to or removed from the table; the row count is the same as the count written down in step 9.

steps.action: Clear the search box.
steps.result: The full list of options is shown again.

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and type `-` in the search box.
steps.result: The options `-`, `--`, `- a`, `- ` and ` - ` are listed; options without a hyphen (for example `Note 1`) are not listed.

steps.action: Tick only the option `-`.
steps.result: The table shows W11, W12 and W13, not W14, W15, W21 or W22.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Job Description` column.
steps.result: The panel is shown; its look is noted.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The panel is shown.

steps.action: Compare fonts, checkbox style, spacing and search box.
steps.result: Both panels use the same components and look the same.

steps.action: Type `W0` in the search box `Search work number and job description`.
steps.result: Only W01 to W09 are shown (Job Descriptions `W01` to `W09`).

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick `Note 1` and `Note 2`.
steps.result: Only W05 and W06 are shown.

steps.action: Sort the `Job Description` column ascending.
steps.result: W05 is shown above W06.

steps.action: Sort it descending.
steps.result: W06 is shown above W05.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Job Owner` column and tick `Somchai Test`.
steps.result: Only W05 is shown.

steps.action: Clear the search box.
steps.result: Only W05 is shown (the Remark and Job Owner filters stay).

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens.

steps.action: Look at the options.
steps.result: `-`, `Note 1`, `Note 2`, `Note 10`, `Test` and all other Remark values of the worklist are listed, not only `Note 1` and `Note 2`.

steps.action: Type `W05` in the search box `Search work number and job description`.
steps.result: Only W05 is shown.

steps.action: Look at the options of the `Remark` filter again.
steps.result: The same options as in step 8 are listed.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens.

steps.action: Read the options for W10, W16, W17, W18 and W19.
steps.result: Each is shown exactly as stored: `ซ่อมด่วน`, `Check valve 🔧`, the 200-character text, `Valve A, B`, `100% ok "x" & y` (no bold text, no cut characters).

steps.action: Type the stored value of one strange Remark into the search box.
steps.result: Only that option is listed.

steps.action: Tick that option.
steps.result: Only its work is shown.

steps.action: Repeat steps 3 and 4 for each strange value.
steps.result: Each time only the matching work is shown and the page stays usable.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The list opens and no alert dialog appears.

steps.action: Read the two options.
steps.result: They read exactly `x` and `` as plain text; the first is not shown in bold.

steps.action: Tick the option `<script>alert(1)</script>`.
steps.result: Only its work is shown, its Remark cell shows the same plain text and no alert dialog appears.

steps.action: Type `<b>` in the search box.
steps.result: The option `x` is listed as plain text.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The panel opens without an error.

steps.action: Look at the list.
steps.result: No `-` option and no value options are listed.

steps.action: Close the panel.
steps.result: The table still shows `No results found`.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column and tick `Valve A, B`.
steps.result: Only W18 is shown.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.result: Only W18 is shown and `Valve A, B` is ticked as one option; no other option is ticked.

steps.action: Untick it and tick `100% ok "x" & y`.
steps.result: Only W19 is shown.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.result: Only W19 is shown and that option is ticked; no other option is ticked.

steps.action: Untick it and tick `-`.
steps.result: W11, W12 and W13 are shown.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.result: W11, W12 and W13 are shown and `-` is ticked; no other option is ticked.

steps.action: Untick it and tick the option with one space before `Test`.
steps.result: Only W03 is shown.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.result: Only W03 is shown and that option is ticked; the option `Test` is not ticked.

steps.action: Before the release, as the test user, set the Remark text filter `Contains` `Note` and the `Job Owner` filter `Somchai Test`.
steps.result: The table shows only works that match both filters.

steps.action: Copy the page address that holds the old Remark parameter and the Job Owner parameter.
steps.result: The old address is saved for later.

steps.action: After the release, log in with the same user and open the Worklist from the Plan Card.
steps.result: The page opens normally with no error message.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The checkbox list opens with `Select All` and every option ticked; no `Contains`, `Blank` or `Not blank` condition is left.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.result: The Remark filter does not narrow the rows: the table shows all works of `Somchai Test`.

steps.action: Open the filter on the `Job Owner` column.
steps.result: Only `Somchai Test` is still ticked (the saved Job Owner filter is unaffected).

steps.action: Click `Reset Table Filter`.
steps.result: All works are shown and the Job Owner filter is cleared.

steps.action: Open the old address from step 2 in a new tab.
steps.result: The Worklist page opens normally without an error message and without a redirect to the Shutdown Event List page.

steps.action: Look at the table and open the filter on the `Remark` column.
steps.result: The table shows only the works of `Somchai Test` (the Job Owner parameter is still applied) and every Remark option is ticked, so the old Remark parameter is ignored.
